scope: Full-size structured Keras/TensorFlow policy on three one-decision Burn task families; not complete MTG games
rewards: Only sampled terminal task outcomes. Real-game terminal win/loss/draw objective is unchanged. No supervised action labels in the selected recipe.

metrics.success_probability: Exact model probability mass on correct actions, not sampled full-game win rate
metrics.greedy: Argmax accuracy on fresh evaluation observations

gate.retention: Every branch must pass at the last three development checkpoints (400, 500, 600); final checkpoint only

limitations: One-decision tasks do not test planning or recurrent credit assignment.
Fresh seeds/states use the same held-out distribution inspected during development; this is not an untouched new card family.
Broader training improves coverage around unseen numeric values; the held-out generator itself is unchanged.
The complete recipe is validated. Individual changes are not all independently isolated.
Value-gradient isolation trains the value head on actor-learned features; full-game suitability remains untested.
Unrelated early development pilot scenarios-v4-pilot had a superseded Charm oracle and are excluded.
